clusters.name: Scrambly grapplers
clusters.description: Hunt submissions and scramble, but get taken down a lot themselves.

clusters.name: Pure strikers
clusters.description: High striking output and almost never shoot for takedowns.

clusters.name: Dominant wrestlers
clusters.description: Most takedowns, least damage taken. Control fights on the mat.

clusters.name: Low-volume all-rounders
clusters.description: Moderate at everything with lower output.

clusters.name: Volume mixers
clusters.description: High-volume strikers who mix in takedowns.
